_comment: Shared line box vectors. Read by coui_core (the role values the table is
written against), coui_flutter (the line height Flutter's text engine lays
out) and the Chrome probe in tool/parity (the line height the browser
computes from the Web emit), so a line box that drifts on one platform
fails against the same numbers the other draws.
Written by hand, not generated: a table read back from the code it checks
cannot fail when that code is wrong.
box: the height in logical px of one line of the text. Flutter's engine
rounds ascent + descent to a whole pixel per line (LineMetrics.height), so
a 14px label at 1.4 sits in 20, not 19.6, and a 16px title at 1.4 in 22,
not 22.4; halfway rounds up (13px body at 1.5 is 20). A fixed box
roles: CoreTypography.coui at the desktop tier, by CoreTextStyles name.
overlays: a size and multiplier stated on a style, the way a component
overrides a role's leading. None of them lands exactly halfway: the engine
multiplies in single precision, so a product the browser holds at .5 can
reach it as .4999 and round the other way.
